t: Six requests, most of them balanced against their opposite
a: أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى
p: Asʾaluka khashyataka fi-l-ghaybi wa-sh-shahādah, wa asʾaluka kalimata-l-ḥaqqi fi-r-riḍā wa-l-ghaḍab, wa asʾaluka-l-qaṣda fi-l-faqri wa-l-ghinā
m: I ask You for awe of You in private and in public, and for the word of truth in contentment and in anger, and for moderation in poverty and in wealth.
